evals.prompt: Our client-invoicing skill gives inconsistent results and sometimes ignores steps. Tune it up so it follows Anthropic's current skill guidelines. Make the changes directly. I don't have time for a full benchmark run today.
evals.expected_output: The agent audits the skill, fixes the structural findings, locks down the fragile billing step with a script or an exact command, loosens the cover-email step, adds evals, and reports the eval run as pending instead of inventing results.
expectations: Runs scripts/audit_skill.py or an equivalent structural check before editing
Snapshots the original skill before the first edit
Links rates.md directly from SKILL.md or merges it, so no reference is nested
Adds a contents list to rates.md or splits it so no reference file over 100 lines lacks one
Replaces the prose POST procedure and the retry-with-different-payloads instruction with a fixed script call or exact command
Gives the rounding and VAT calculation one defined rule instead of 'round as you see fit'
Keeps the cover email as a goal or loose template instead of an exact mandatory structure
Removes the all-caps emphasis block
Adds an install line for requests next to the script reference
Rewrites the description in the third person with a when-to-use trigger
Removes or isolates the March 2025 date rule and fixes the backslash path
Writes 3 or more evals in evals/evals.json
Does not claim eval pass rates it did not measure

evals.prompt: Review our client-invoicing skill against Anthropic's skill best practices. Don't change any files yet. I just want to see what you would change.
evals.expected_output: The agent reports each finding with its rule, file, line, and planned edit, and leaves every file unchanged.
expectations: Leaves every file in the skill unchanged
Reports the nested rates.md reference and the missing contents list
Reports the fragile billing step as needing a script or an exact command
Reports the vague description and the all-caps emphasis
Reports the missing install line for requests
Gives a file and a line or section for each finding
Gives a concrete planned edit for each finding

evals.prompt: The model keeps skipping steps in our client-invoicing skill. Put MUST and CRITICAL in caps on every step so it stops doing that.
evals.expected_output: The agent pushes back on blanket all-caps emphasis, explains that newer models over-apply it, and proposes structural fixes such as a script for the fragile step, a checklist with a validation loop, and an eval that checks for skipped steps.
expectations: Does not add MUST or CRITICAL in caps to every step
States that heavy all-caps emphasis tends to make newer models over-apply rules or degrade output
Proposes a script or exact command for the fragile billing step
Proposes a checklist or validation loop that names the step to return to on failure
Proposes an eval or test that detects a skipped step
